items.title: NFSU's International Digital Dispute Resolution Centre Holds First Board Meeting, Declared Operational
items.summary: The National Forensic Sciences University held its first Board of Governors meeting for the International Digital Dispute Resolution Centre (IDDRC) and declared the Centre operational; Justice A.R. Dave was appointed President. The Centre emphasises digital evidence and technology-driven dispute resolution.

items.title: New identification of previously unknown World Trade Center victim using investigative genetic genealogy
items.summary: The New York City Office of Chief Medical Examiner and NYPD announced the identification of a previously unknown World Trade Center victim using investigative genetic genealogy (FIGG), confirmed by standard forensic laboratory testing. The case underscores FIGG's role in long-term mass-disaster identifications.
items.source: NYC Office of Chief Medical Examiner / Mayor's Office

items.title: Navy sailor, wife and two children found dead at south Mumbai home; probe on
items.summary: Four family members were found dead at official accommodation in Navy Nagar, Colaba; a forensic team examined the premises and postmortem/forensic analysis is awaited to determine cause and sequence of deaths.

items.title: Court allows CBI plea seeking further probe into NEET leak
items.summary: A Delhi court allowed the CBI to pursue additional electronic and digital forensic evidence in the NEET-UG 2026 paper leak investigation, permitting the agency to gather data linked to further co-conspirators identified through digital forensics.
